o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آغز, from Proto-Turkic *āgïŕ. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰍𐰕 (g¹z /⁠aɣïz⁠/), etc.
From Proto-Mongolic *solagai (“left”). By surface analysis, sol + -axay. See Kyrgyz сологой (sologoy) for cognates.
From hökm + -dar. Compare Ottoman Turkish حكمدار (hükümdar). Possibly from there.
